title: DO THIS *BEFORE* The Tesla SpaceX Merger!!
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Expects SpaceX to issue shares and acquire Tesla at ~30%+ premium, most likely between Jan 2027 and Jul 2028, before a 2029 Democratic antitrust window.
Without an Iran deal, Tesla and SpaceX could fall substantially and the economy could slide into recession.

calls.condition: Buy dips at 347 bounce (295 if revisited on no Iran deal); expects >414 when an Iran deal comes
calls.reason: Tesla holders likely get a ~30% premium buyout from SpaceX in 2027-28, which acts like a put under the stock; 347 is a recurring bounce level.
calls.quote: it makes more sense to buy Tesla on what feels like an almost certain acquisition because you were getting paid out bigly

calls.reason: SpaceX would issue dilutive shares and pay a premium on an already premium Tesla valuation.
calls.quote: I hate to say it, but it's kind of bearish SpaceX shares because you're basically paying a premium on a premium

notes: No date in transcript. SpaceX ticker not stated; recorded as 'SPACEX' (relative-value view vs Tesla). 414 target is conditional on an Iran deal; mentions Kalshi merger odds as sponsor.
